events.address: Madison Square Park, Fifth Ave & Broadway at 23rd St, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: A free four-day US Open fan hub from IBM with AI-powered tennis activations, live match viewing, an AI photo booth, serve-speed testing and an AI-enabled ping-pong experience.
events.what_is_free: Public admission to the fan experience and advertised IBM activations is free. The event also promotes giveaways and live US Open viewing; giveaway inventory is not guaranteed to every attendee.
events.caveats: IBM's official announcement explicitly describes this as a free public four-day fan experience. Match-viewing start times differ by date, and giveaways are promotional rather than guaranteed.
events.practical_notes: September 11: 9 AM–9 PM with men's semifinals coverage beginning at 3 PM. September 12: 11 AM–8 PM with the women's final at 4 PM. September 13: 11 AM–7 PM with the men's final at 2 PM. The activation is at the southeast corner of Madison Square Park adjacent to IBM's One Madison Avenue office.
